hf.title: WeVisForensics: Self-Evolving Agent for Omni AI-Generated Video Detection
hf.abstract: Recent advances in video generation call for reliable detection grounded in explicit forensic evidence. However, current methods primarily depend on single-pass chain-of-thought reasoning that overlooks brief or localized artifacts, or on predefined multi-agent workflows that offer limited flexibility in selecting relevant inspections. Even with adaptive investigation, optimizing the investigation policy alone does not directly improve the forensic capabilities of fixed experts. We introduce WeVisForensics, an agentic framework in which a main investigator agent coordinates a self-evolving library of forensic inspector sub-agents spanning visual and audio cues. The investigator learns which artifact type to examine, over which window, and when to conclude, and these interactions provide shared feedback for both levels of agents. Our dual-timescale policy optimization strategy, DTPO, closes this loop through fast reinforcement learning of the investigator and slower refinement of the inspectors, guided by annotated artifact intervals, to report subtle artifacts they once dismissed. Furthermore, we curate ForenCue-30K, combining role-specific forensic annotations and interaction trajectories to supervise individual inspections and their coordination, with an accompanying reinforcement-learning pool. Experiments show that WeVisForensics averages 95.2% detection accuracy across in-domain, out-of-domain and agentic benchmarks, 9.0% above the strongest prior detector, while grounding its verdicts in localized evidence.
hf.titleZh: WeVisForensics:用于全模态 AI 生成视频检测的自进化 Agent
hf.summaryZh: AI 生成视频检测需要可定位的取证证据，而单次思维链推理容易漏掉局部细微伪影，预定义的多智能体流程也缺乏灵活性，且仅优化调查策略无法提升固定专家的取证能力。WeVisForensics 由一个主调查 Agent 调度一个可自进化的取证检查器子 Agent 库(覆盖视觉与音频线索)，学习检查哪类伪影、在哪个时间窗、何时结束，两级 Agent 共享交互反馈;配套的 DTPO 双时间尺度策略优化以快慢两档强化学习闭环更新调查者与检查器，并构建 ForenCue-30K 提供角色化取证标注与交互轨迹监督。在域内、域外与 Agentic 基准上平均检测准确率 95.2%，超过最强先前检测器 9.0 个百分点，且判定可溯源到局部证据。
hf.reason: 自进化多智能体+双时间尺度 RL，方法契合 Agentic RL，但属取证垂直应用

hf.title: Mind2Act World: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Embodied Mind, Physical Action, and Mind-Action Composition in Robotic Manipulation
hf.abstract: Embodied intelligence aims to let robots perform complex physical tasks with human-like adaptability and reliability, which requires three complementary capabilities: history-based cognitive reasoning, precise and timely physical execution, and the composition of reasoning and execution through environmental feedback. Yet existing benchmarks either evaluate reasoning and execution within the same tasks or assess them separately without their composition, so they reveal little about whether a failure comes from reasoning, execution, or their composition. We introduce Mind2Act World, a diagnostic benchmark of 30 simulated manipulation tasks from five real-world application domains. Each task has three difficulty levels and two scene settings (Clean and Random), yielding 180 configurations. The tasks form three views: Mind tests decisions based on past observations, Act tests precise and timely execution, and Mind2Act combines both in closed-loop tasks where action outcomes guide later decisions. Comparing the three views shows whether a system lacks a capability or fails to compose capabilities it already has. A diagnosis harness further attributes the failed episodes of three representative systems to Mind, Act, or their composition and summarizes each system in a profile card. Our evaluation of multimodal agents, vision-language-action models (VLAs), and world-action models (WAMs) shows that competence in a single view does not carry over to Mind2Act tasks. Even the strongest agent succeeds in 52.7% of Mind and 39.0% of Act episodes but in only 12.0% of Mind2Act episodes. The strongest agent retains task state but struggles with sustained contact, whereas end-to-end policies execute practiced motions but retain little task state. These findings point to composing reasoning and execution through environmental feedback as the main open problem.
hf.titleZh: Mind2Act World：面向机器人操作中具身心智、物理动作与心智-动作组合的诊断基准
hf.summaryZh: 现有基准要么在同一任务中同时评测推理与执行、要么将二者分离评测，难以判断失败究竟来自推理、执行还是二者的组合。为此构建 Mind2Act World，含 5 个真实应用域的 30 个仿真操作任务，每类任务设三个难度与 Clean/Random 两种场景，共 180 种配置，并划分 Mind、Act、Mind2Act 三个视图做闭环诊断，配套的 diagnosis harness 可将失败片段归因并生成系统画像卡。评测多模态智能体、VLA 与 WAM 显示，单视图能力无法迁移到组合任务：最强智能体在 Mind 与 Act 上分别成功 52.7% 与 39.0%，在 Mind2Act 上仅 12.0%；该智能体能保持任务状态但难以维持接触，端到端策略则相反。结果指向以环境反馈组合推理与执行是主要开放问题。
hf.reason: 具身评测基准，诊断推理与执行组合，方法学有分量

hf.title: Probing the "Conscious" Mind: Selective Access and Global Workspace in Vision-Language Models
hf.abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) integrate visual and textual information, but their outputs do not reveal internal concept representations. Global workspace theory (GWT) proposes that information is selected from parallel brain processes, integrated in a shared workspace, and made available to specialised processes. We introduce the Multimodal Concept Lens (MC-Lens), a multimodal Jacobian lens, to study these functions in VLM concept processing. Its vision encoder and language decoder lenses map intermediate states to a shared semantic space defined by the decoder's output vocabulary to compare concept accessibility across modalities. MC-Lens supports internal concept interventions to examine the role of accessed concepts in downstream computation. (i) Accessibility and selective access. Multimodal concept information is readable in intermediate states and selectively accessible as tasks require. We extend "readout carriers" from one name token to a token set to better capture and express concept information and support counterfactual experiments. (ii) Concepts in downstream computation. Counterfactual experiments show that accessed concept information participates in downstream computation and reasoning. (iii) Development of cross-modal alignment and selective access. We develop two J-space metrics tracking the development of cross-modal concept alignment more clearly than hidden state cosine in controlled VLM training. The experiment also shows that reliable selective access develops later than concept accessibility. (iv) Shared functions across models. Across VLM families and sizes, we find shared patterns of concept accessibility, query-dependent selectivity and cross-task intervention effects despite differences in internal organisation. These findings offer an experimental basis to study GWT in multimodal artificial systems and how it can guide cross-modal alignment improvements.
hf.titleZh: 探测「意识」心智：视觉语言模型中的选择性访问与全局工作空间
hf.summaryZh: 视觉语言模型的输出无法揭示其内部概念表征，全局工作空间理论（GWT）则主张信息经选择后在共享工作空间整合并供专门加工使用。为此提出多模态概念透镜MC-Lens，用视觉编码器与语言解码器两侧的Jacobian透镜把中间状态映射到解码器输出词表定义的共享语义空间，从而跨模态比较概念可访问性，并支持对内部概念做干预；同时把readout carrier从单个名称token扩展为token集合以承载概念信息。结果显示概念信息在中间层可读，并随任务需要被选择性访问；反事实实验表明被访问的概念参与下游计算与推理；两个J-space指标比隐状态余弦相似度更清晰地追踪跨模态概念对齐的发展，且可靠的选择性访问晚于概念可访问性出现。跨VLM家族与规模均观察到可访问性、查询相关选择性和跨任务干预效应的共性模式，为在多模态人工系统中实验研究GWT及改进跨模态对齐提供了基础。
hf.reason: VLM内部概念表征的可解释性探测，属多模态理解侧扎实分析工作

hf.title: WeMM-Video: Pushing the Frontiers of Open-Source Omni-Modal Video Understanding
hf.abstract: Video understanding, particularly with accompanying audio, remains a central challenge in multimodal intelligence. In this report, we introduce WeMM-Video, a family of Chinese-English bilingual omni-modal foundation models spanning 2B, 4B, 9B, and 35B-A3B variants. Centering on joint audio-visual perception and reasoning, WeMM-Video unifies text, image, audio, and video processing within a hybrid-thinking paradigm, seamlessly supporting both a non-thinking instruct mode for fast, direct responses and a thinking mode for explicit step-by-step reasoning. The models are trained on a large-scale multimodal corpus of approximately 1.2 trillion tokens through progressive pre-training and a multi-stage post-training pipeline incorporating multi-teacher OPD, anti-repetition MrDPO, and specialist RL. Evaluated across more than 120 benchmarks, WeMM-Video demonstrates superior performance in omni-modal video understanding and reasoning, while maintaining highly competitive capabilities across general audio, silent video, image, and text tasks. Specifically, in omni-modal video evaluations, our flagship WeMM-Video-35B-A3B establishes a new open-source state of the art, substantially outperforming proprietary models such as Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash and Seed2.0-Mini-0428 while narrowing the gap with the strong Gemini-3.0-Flash, and our compact WeMM-Video-9B surpasses the larger open-source Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct. We publicly release the WeMM-Video family along with our evaluation and reproduction pipeline to foster further research and development in the open-source community.
hf.titleZh: WeMM-Video：推动开源全模态视频理解的前沿
hf.summaryZh: 针对带音频的视频理解这一多模态智能核心难题，构建中英双语全模态模型家族WeMM-Video（2B/4B/9B/35B-A3B），把文本、图像、音频、视频统一到混合思考范式，兼有直答的instruct模式与显式逐步推理的thinking模式。训练上先以约1.2万亿token多模态语料渐进式预训练，再用多教师OPD、抗重复MrDPO与专家RL做多阶段后训练。在120余个基准上，旗舰35B-A3B在全模态视频评测中刷新开源SOTA，超过Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash与Seed2.0-Mini-0428、逼近Gemini-3.0-Flash，9B版本亦胜过Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct。模型家族与评测复现流程均已开源，可供全模态理解与后训练研究直接复用。
hf.reason: 全模态视频理解旗舰技术报告，OPD/MrDPO/RL后训练管线可拆解

hf.title: Posterior Matching Distillation
hf.abstract: Diffusion distillation accelerates image and video generation by compressing a pretrained teacher's iterative sampling process into a few network evaluations. Distribution-based methods achieve this by matching the student's output distribution to the teacher's. This matching is often driven by reverse-KL objectives, whose mode-seeking bias favors dominant teacher modes at the expense of diversity across samples. We introduce Posterior Matching Distillation (PMD), a new member of the distribution-based distillation family that combines mode-covering posterior sampling with any-step generation. At zero population loss, PMD recovers the teacher's full posterior of clean images at each trained noise level. Its stochastic student supports any-step sampling budgets within the trained timestep grid without further training. To learn these posteriors, PMD matches exponentially reweighted averages of student samples conditioned on a fixed noisy state to corresponding teacher posterior means. Under Gaussian corruption, exponentially tilted posterior mean is a single teacher evaluation at a shifted input. We prove that, matching tilted means over an open neighborhood uniquely identifies the full posterior. PMD thus supervises the entire conditional distribution through a family of mean constraints, without any auxiliary student-score network. Experiments on SDXL and FLUX.2 [klein] 4B demonstrate that PMD achieves the best FID among 4-step methods on both models, while maintaining competitive or leading performance across prompt-alignment and perceptual-quality metrics.
hf.titleZh: 后验匹配蒸馏（Posterior Matching Distillation）
hf.summaryZh: 扩散蒸馏把预训练教师模型的迭代采样压缩为少步生成，而基于分布匹配的方法多依赖 reverse-KL，存在众数寻求偏向，牺牲样本多样性。PMD 改为匹配后验分布:在固定噪声状态下，将学生样本的指数重加权均值对齐到教师后验均值;在高斯扰动下，该倾斜后验均值只需在偏移输入处做一次教师前向，作者并证明在开邻域上匹配倾斜均值可唯一确定完整后验，无需辅助学生得分网络。学生具备随机性，可在已训练时间步网格内支持任意步数采样预算。在 SDXL 与 FLUX.2 [klein] 4B 上，PMD 在 4 步方法中取得最优 FID，提示对齐与感知质量指标也保持领先或有竞争力。
hf.reason: 扩散蒸馏用于图像生成，属明确低分方向

hf.title: Coda-DaVinci: Reimagining Video Generation with Code2Video
hf.abstract: Code2Video uses agent-authored 3D proxies to guide video generation, enabling explicit control over structure and dynamics. However, how to construct proxies and prompts for optimal downstream quality remains underexplored, as do the capabilities and limitations of this paradigm. Through controlled experiments and blinded human evaluation, we study proxy granularity, physics simulation, and prompting. The results reveal task-dependent trade-offs: coarse proxies favor natural motion, while medium-grained proxies favor consistency. Physics simulation and proxy-aligned prompting further improve average quality. Guided by these findings, we introduce Coda-DaVinci, a task-adaptive agentic framework for Code2Video generation that selects between proxy-guided and direct generation, adapts modeling granularity to each entity, and coordinates simulation with proxy-grounded prompting. Its multi-agent harness preserves scene assets and guides repairs through visual inspection and independent review. Experiments demonstrate leading instruction following on VTR and scene consistency on R2M, improved physical plausibility over direct generation, and higher visual realism than the compared Code2Video baselines. Long-video evaluations further show gains in event structure and consistency across successive interactions, while revealing limitations in transition stability and adherence to scene settings.
hf.titleZh: Coda-DaVinci:用Code2Video重新构想视频生成
hf.summaryZh: Code2Video让智能体编写3D代理来引导视频生成，但代理与提示该如何构造、该范式的边界仍不清楚。工作以受控实验与盲评考察代理粒度、物理仿真与提示设计:粗粒度代理利于自然运动，中粒度代理利于一致性，物理仿真与代理对齐提示提升平均质量。据此提出任务自适应多智能体框架Coda-DaVinci，按实体自适应选择建模拟粒度、在代理引导与直接生成之间切换，并以视觉检查与独立评审驱动修复。VTR指令遵循与R2M场景一致性领先，物理合理性与视觉真实感优于Code2Video基线，长视频的事件结构与连贯性有改善，但转场稳定性与场景设定遵循仍存局限。
hf.reason: 核心是视频生成，仅多智能体harness与Agent方向沾边

hf.title: The Mask Is Not the Object: Volumetric Supervision for 3D Gaussian Segmentation
hf.abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting enables object-level operations on Gaussian primitives, yet existing segmentation methods are largely trained and evaluated through rendered views. This mismatch can produce accurate rendered masks from incomplete 3D selections since alpha-blended feature supervision concentrates learning on dominant contributors while leaving occluded or low-contribution Gaussians weakly supervised. We propose VODA, a plug-and-play supervision objective that exploits local depth structure to group per-pixel contributors and directly supervises all Gaussians in selected depth clusters, bypassing contribution-weighted gradient delivery. To evaluate volumetric completeness, we introduce Removal-3D, a synthetic object-removal benchmark, and the Removal Depth Error (RDE), a metric comparing predicted and ground-truth depth changes. Across four rendering-based baselines, VODA consistently improves volumetric segmentation on Removal-3D while maintaining or improving performance on LERF and ScanNet. Further analysis shows that VODA recovers lower-contribution Gaussians, while simple gradient reweighting and spatial propagation fail to reproduce comparable gains.
hf.titleZh: 掩码并非物体本身:面向3D高斯分割的体积监督
hf.summaryZh: 现有3D高斯分割方法大多通过渲染视图来训练和评估，渲染掩码准确并不等于三维选择完整:alpha混合的特征监督会把学习集中在主导贡献的高斯上，遮挡或低贡献高斯仅得到弱监督。VODA作为一种即插即用的监督目标，利用局部深度结构对逐像素贡献者分组，直接监督所选深度簇内的全部高斯，绕开按贡献加权的梯度传递。为衡量体积完整性，作者构建合成物体移除基准Removal-3D并提出移除深度误差RDE;在四个基于渲染的基线上，VODA在Removal-3D上一致提升体积分割，并在LERF与ScanNet上保持或提升表现。分析表明该方法能找回低贡献高斯，而简单的梯度重加权与空间传播无法复现同等收益。
hf.reason: 3D高斯泼溅分割，属视觉重建方向，与LLM关注点无关

hf.title: Depth Pro 2: Sharp and Temporally Consistent Metric Monocular Depth
hf.abstract: We present Depth Pro 2, an approach to estimating dense metric depth for images and video at full resolution. By analyzing prior methods for monocular depth estimation, we find that they commonly trade off temporal consistency and boundary sharpness: multi-frame methods favor consistency, single-frame methods favor sharpness. To overcome this trade-off, we train a single, scalable network that processes both images and video and predicts depth maps at native resolution. Depth Pro 2 produces depth maps that are metrically accurate, sharp, and temporally consistent all at once, outperforming prior work in all of these dimensions. We release a family of models that define a new Pareto frontier in terms of metric accuracy, sharpness, temporal consistency, and runtime. We release code and weights at https://apple-aiml-research.github.io/ml-depth-pro-2/
hf.titleZh: Depth Pro 2：清晰且时序一致的度量单目深度
hf.summaryZh: 单目深度估计长期面临一个两难：多帧方法偏好时序一致性，单帧方法偏好边界锐利，二者难以兼得。Depth Pro 2 训练单一可扩展网络，同时处理图像与视频，并以原生分辨率预测深度图，从而同时获得度量精度、边界锐利度与时序一致性。该方法在三个维度上均优于先前工作，并发布了一组在度量精度、锐利度、时序一致性与运行时之间划定新 Pareto 前沿的模型系列。
hf.reason: 单目深度估计属视觉重建方向，与 LLM 关注点无关

hf.title: EgoCaptioner: Towards Comprehensive and Fine-Grained Egocentric Video Captioning
hf.abstract: Egocentric video captioning requires fine-grained detail and accurate timing, yet current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) often miss brief actions, confuse their order, or misinterpret the wearer's motion. Existing caption formats also offer limited support for combining detailed narration with precise timing. We present EgoCaptioner, which pairs a video-level overview of the setting, participants, and the wearer's overall activity with timed steps whose narration adapts to varying perceptual demands and marks key moments at specific timestamps. We develop a coarse-to-fine annotation pipeline that establishes event structure before expanding step descriptions, yielding 50,000 training examples from eight egocentric video sources. Complementary rewards assess factual accuracy and coverage, measure step-level temporal alignment, and penalize fragmented or redundant narration, guiding caption refinement through Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). To improve the reliability of factual supervision, we supplement caption references with pose-derived motion facts when sensor data are available. Across five egocentric benchmarks, EgoCaptioner achieves leading performance among evaluated open-source models in caption quality, caption-conditioned question answering, and temporal alignment. It also surpasses Gemini 3.1 Pro on PhysCapBench and all evaluated proprietary baselines on Minerva-Ego under the caption-to-QA protocol. Ablations support the complementary roles of factual and temporal rewards and show that coarse-to-fine annotation provides more effective supervision than single-pass annotation.
hf.titleZh: EgoCaptioner：迈向全面且细粒度的第一人称视频描述
hf.summaryZh: 针对多模态大模型在第一人称视频描述中常常漏掉短暂动作、混淆动作顺序、误读佩戴者自身运动的问题，提出「视频级概览＋带时间戳的分步描述」格式：概览覆盖场景、参与者与佩戴者的整体活动，分步描述按感知需求自适应展开并标注关键时刻。配套由粗到细的标注流水线先确定事件结构再扩写步骤，从八类第一人称视频来源得到 5 万条训练样本；训练时以事实准确性与覆盖度、步骤级时序对齐、碎片与冗余惩罚等多重互补奖励，通过 GRPO 迭代精修描述，并在有传感器数据时用姿态推导的运动事实补强事实监督。在五个第一人称 benchmark 上，描述质量、描述条件问答与时序对齐均居所评开源模型首位，PhysCapBench 上超过 Gemini 3.1 Pro，Minerva-Ego 的描述转问答协议下优于全部所评闭源基线。
hf.reason: 第一人称视频描述＋多奖励GRPO后训练，命中多模态与后训练方向

hf.title: AltRA-Test: An Alternative Annotator Test for LLM Judges Without Shared Annotators
hf.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as judges and graders to replace human annotators, raising the question of when such replacement is statistically justified. To support such decisions, the Alternative Annotator Test (Alt-Test) was introduced for dense settings where all items are annotated by the same annotators. However, in many large-scale annotation settings, items are annotated by different subsets of annotators. We therefore propose the Alternative Annotator Test with Resampled Annotations (AltRA-Test), a statistical test that does not require that all items are annotated by the same annotators. AltRA-Test uses a bootstrap that resamples items, draws k human annotations for each item, and substitutes one of them with an LLM annotation. This produces paired all-human and mixed human-LLM panels. A replacement is supported when the inter-annotator agreement (IAA) of the mixed panel is statistically non-inferior to the IAA of the all-human panel, i.e., when the LLM preserves the signal that the human annotators share. We establish that AltRA-Test is a consistent test of asymptotic level alpha. We then evaluate it through simulations and real-world experiments in which we test 18 LLMs and 5 prompting techniques on 20 datasets across text, image, audio, and video. Across these evaluations, about 100 items often suffice for the test. In simulations, where we know whether the LLM is a better or a worse annotator than the humans, AltRA-Test makes more correct replacement decisions than existing baselines. In real-world data experiments, LLMs pass the test in about half of the setups, depending mainly on the task. Since replacement is not always justified, we encourage researchers to test it for their task.
hf.titleZh: AltRA-Test：无需共享标注者的LLM评判者替代标注者检验
hf.summaryZh: LLM作为judge替代人类标注是否在统计上成立，已有检验要求所有条目由同一批标注者标注，难以适用于条目由不同标注者子集标注的大规模标注场景。AltRA-Test通过bootstrap重采样条目，为每个条目抽取k个人类标注并用一个LLM标注替换其中之一，构造配对的全人类面板与混合人-LLM面板，以混合面板的标注者间一致性（IAA）不劣于全人类面板作为替代成立的判据，并证明其为渐近水平α的一致检验。在覆盖文本、图像、音频、视频的20个数据集上测试18个LLM与5种提示方法，约100个条目通常即可完成检验；模拟中相比基线做出更多正确的替代决策，真实数据中约半数设置通过。
hf.reason: LLM-as-judge替代标注的统计检验，属评估方法学，直接相关

hf.title: HiUni: Harmonizing Understanding and Generation in Shared Visual Space
hf.abstract: Unified multimodal models aim to support visual understanding and generation within a single framework. However, prevailing approaches often separate their visual representations or backbone computation to accommodate the different requirements of these two tasks, which limits the degree of unification. In this paper, we present HiUni, which revisits this design choice and explores whether a pretrained vision language model can be directly extended into a unified model with extensive parameter sharing. Specifically, HiUni reuses the same language-aligned ViT and dense Transformer backbone for both capabilities, while confining task-specific computation to the output side. Yet such a design introduces two key challenges. Generation in pixel space is difficult to optimize, and semantic abstraction in pretrained ViT discards fine spatial details required for synthesis. To address these challenges, HiUni introduces a Pixel Diffusion Head tailored to direct pixel-space optimization and a lightweight HiGate pathway that provides fine-grained spatial details near the output stage. Extensive experiments show that HiUni achieves a similar average understanding score to the pretrained VLM while attaining competitive performance on image generation and editing. Controlled comparisons and analyses further demonstrate that a single dense backbone can effectively support both capabilities without task-specific backbone computation, highlighting a simpler path toward unified multimodal modeling.
hf.titleZh: HiUni：在共享视觉空间中统一理解与生成
hf.summaryZh: 统一多模态模型常为理解与生成分别设计视觉表示或骨干计算，限制了参数共享程度。HiUni 让两类能力复用同一个语言对齐 ViT 与稠密 Transformer 骨干，仅将任务特定计算留在输出侧：用 Pixel Diffusion Head 直接在像素空间优化生成，并用轻量 HiGate 通路在输出阶段补回 ViT 语义抽象所丢弃的细粒度空间细节。实验表明其理解平均分与预训练 VLM 相当，图像生成与编辑也具竞争力，对照分析进一步说明单一稠密骨干即可同时支撑两类能力。
hf.reason: 统一多模态架构有价值，但生成侧依赖扩散，与关注重心有距离

hf.title: TuringSpace: Grounding Spatial Intelligence in Action with Interactive CAPTCHAs
hf.abstract: Humans act in the visual world by inferring the 3D layout behind a 2D view, predicting how an action changes it, and correcting themselves after seeing the result. Can multimodal large language models (MLLMs) do the same? CAPTCHAs offer a natural test, since humans solve them through this very loop, clicking and dragging on the screen and adjusting after each result. Yet existing CAPTCHA benchmarks are largely solved and rarely spatial, while spatial benchmarks rarely require action. We therefore present TuringSpace, a synthetic web environment of 125 interactive CAPTCHAs that span five spatial abilities and must be solved through clicks and drags on the screen. Every task is a program that generates new instances with a checker and an oracle, so the tasks also form a scalable training gym. Humans solve 94.1% of the tasks, whereas the best model, GPT-6 Astra, still fails 25.9% of them, and the best open-weight model, Kimi K3, fails 68.0%. Our further analysis shows that most failures come from misreading the screenshot, and that model reasoning rarely corrects a wrong belief but hallucinates evidence to defend it. To test whether such spatial abilities can be learned, we fine-tune Qwen3.5-9B on this gym. Its success rate rises from 1.6% to 33.1%, above Kimi K3, and it improves on all seven out-of-distribution benchmarks, including a 9.9-point gain on the real-world indoor videos of VSI-Bench. These results show that grounding spatial intelligence in screen actions exposes what MLLMs lack and offers a scalable way to teach it, with gains that transfer to real-world scenes. We will release TuringSpace to support further study.
hf.titleZh: TuringSpace:用交互式 CAPTCHA 把空间智能锚定在动作中
hf.summaryZh: 现有 CAPTCHA 基准大多已被模型攻破且缺乏空间性，空间基准又很少要求交互动作；TuringSpace 构建了 125 个需点击、拖拽完成的交互式 CAPTCHA 合成网页环境，覆盖五类空间能力，每类任务由程序生成新实例并配检查器与 oracle，可兼作可扩展训练场。人类成功率达 94.1%，最强模型 GPT-6 Astra 仍有 25.9% 失败，开源最强 Kimi K3 失败 68.0%；失败多源于误读截图，且推理会为错误判断臆造证据。在 Qwen3.5-9B 上微调后成功率由 1.6% 升至 33.1%，七个分布外基准全面提升（VSI-Bench 提升 9.9 点）。
hf.reason: MLLM 空间理解基准兼训练场，含微调与迁移验证

hf.title: ZeroVLN: Learning to Navigate without Supervised Fine-Tuning of the VLM Brain
hf.abstract: Representative vision-language navigation (VLN) methods typically couple a vision-language model (VLM) brain with a learnable action head and fine-tune the VLM brain on navigation-domain data to predict geometric goals. However, such adaptation can substantially alter base VLM weights and degrade general visual capabilities. We introduce ZeroVLN, a slow-fast navigation framework that achieves effective navigation with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain. Rather than teaching the brain to predict geometric goals, we equip it with a semantic tool-calling interface for conveying movement decisions to an action expert in natural language. We first adapt the action expert to carry out these movement requests, then jointly improve the brain's movement decisions and the action expert's continuous execution through closed-loop reinforcement learning (RL). Trained on the same navigation episodes, ZeroVLN substantially outperforms representative SFT-based hierarchical VLN methods on standard VLN-CE (continuous environments) benchmarks, while inducing only minor changes to the brain's weights and largely preserving its general capabilities. To our knowledge, ZeroVLN is the first slow-fast VLN framework with zero navigation-domain SFT of the VLM brain, and the first to jointly optimize its slow and fast policies through closed-loop agentic RL in VLN-CE.
hf.titleZh: ZeroVLN:不微调 VLM 大脑的导航学习
hf.summaryZh: 代表性视觉语言导航(VLN)方法把 VLM 大脑与可学习动作头耦合，并在导航数据上微调 VLM 以预测几何目标，但这会显著改动基座权重、削弱通用视觉能力。ZeroVLN 提出快慢双系统框架，对 VLM 大脑做零导航域 SFT:大脑通过语义工具调用接口用自然语言向动作专家下达移动指令，先适配动作专家执行这些请求，再用闭环强化学习联合优化大脑的决策与动作专家的连续执行。在相同导航数据上，该方法在 VLN-CE 基准上大幅优于代表性的 SFT 分层 VLN 方法，且对大脑权重改动很小、基本保留其通用能力。这是首个 VLM 大脑零导航域 SFT 的快慢 VLN 框架，也是 VLN-CE 中首个用闭环智能体式 RL 联合优化快慢策略的工作。
hf.reason: VLA 式导航智能体，零 SFT 加闭环 RL 联合优化，命中具身智能体方向

hf.title: RL Post-Training in Diffusion Transformers Is Activation Steering
hf.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) post-training substantially improves the visual quality, text rendering, and compositional accuracy of diffusion transformers. Because capabilities such as rendering requested text or composing multiple objects are inherently prompt-dependent, a natural hypothesis is that improving them requires learning complex, input-dependent transformations. To isolate how much of these gains an input-independent shift explains, we probe each RL-tuned model with a deliberately simple parameterization: a fixed set of steering vectors added to the block outputs of the frozen base model. On SD3.5-M, these vectors hold 65x fewer parameters than the RL-tuned LoRA (0.29M against 18.8M). We fit them to match the velocity predictions of public RL-tuned checkpoints, with no reward in the objective. Although the vectors are identical for every prompt, token, and sampling seed, they recover 90.0-96.3% of the reward gains of six RL-tuned image models, and 89.8% and 111.9% on two RL-tuned video models. Initialized at zero and trained with online RL, the vectors alone exceed the reward gains of weight-based RL on text rendering (OCR) and human preference (PickScore) on SD3.5-M. A constant shift thus suffices for most of the gain of policy-gradient RL post-training: without new input-dependent transformations, it steers the pretrained generator toward what it can already compute.
hf.titleZh: 扩散 Transformer 中的 RL 后训练本质上是激活引导
hf.summaryZh: 为厘清扩散 Transformer 的 RL 后训练为何能提升视觉质量、文字渲染与组合准确率，在冻结基座模型各 block 输出上加一组与输入无关的固定引导向量来拟合 RL 检查点的速度预测。该向量仅 0.29M 参数，比 RL 调好的 LoRA 少 65 倍，目标函数不含奖励，却恢复六个图像模型 90.0–96.3% 的奖励增益，两个视频模型上为 89.8% 与 111.9%。零初始化后用在线 RL 训练，单靠这些向量在 SD3.5-M 的文字渲染(OCR)与人类偏好(PickScore)上超过基于权重的 RL。说明策略梯度 RL 后训练的大部分收益可由一个常量偏移实现，只是把预训练生成器导向它本就会计算的方向。
hf.reason: 对象是扩散图像/视频生成，属低分方向，仅与后训练沾边

hf.title: WAM-Policy: World Action Models with On-Policy Distillation for Quadrupedal Loco-Manipulation
hf.abstract: Arm-free quadrupeds can perform loco-manipulation, walking on three legs while manipulating with a front leg, yet no existing policy for it follows language instructions. World action models (WAMs) have emerged as effective language-conditioned manipulation policies, but are pretrained for robot arms and sample slowly. WAM-Policy turns one WAM into a quadrupedal loco-manipulation policy via two stages. The first, Cross-Morphology Policy Adaptation and Acceleration, adapts the arm-centric WAM to quadrupeds and distills the transferred policy into a student with one video and two action steps by on-policy self-distillation (OPSD). This student, however, is bounded by its teacher, which only imitates demonstrations. The second stage, Task-Specific Improvement and Merging, therefore tunes the teacher by reinforcement learning (RL) and merges the slow specialists into one few-step student by multi-teacher on-policy distillation (M-OPD). On QLM-Bench, ten simulated tasks with 1,000 demonstrations synthesized without teleoperation, the transferred policy reaches 77.0%, and the OPSD student keeps 76.7% while sampling 14 times faster. Task-specific RL and M-OPD lift it to 85.0%. We also deploy the OPSD student on a real Unitree Go2 Air. WAM-Policy thus achieves a stronger quadrupedal policy at a fraction of the inference cost.
hf.titleZh: WAM-Policy：面向四足机器人移动操作的世界动作模型与同策略蒸馏
hf.summaryZh: 让无臂四足机器人用三条腿行走、前腿操作并听懂语言指令：把面向机械臂预训练的 world action model 迁移为四足 loco-manipulation 策略。第一阶段做跨形态适配与加速，用 on-policy self-distillation 将迁移后的策略蒸馏成只需1个视频步、2个动作步的学生；第二阶段用 RL 微调教师，再以 multi-teacher on-policy distillation 把多个慢教师合并为单一少步学生。在 QLM-Bench 十个仿真任务、1000条无需遥操作的合成演示上，迁移策略达77.0%，学生保持76.7%且采样快14倍，加入 RL 与 M-OPD 后升至85.0%，并在 Unitree Go2 Air 真机部署。
hf.reason: WAM 跨形态迁移加同策略蒸馏，属 VLA 后训练高分方向

hf.title: Training Vision Models for LLM-Driven Weight-Space Programming
hf.abstract: It has been demonstrated that, in certain settings, large language models can perform weight-space programming to directly modify the weights of neural networks. However, it is unknown how dedicated training of these networks can contribute to the successes of weight-space programming. We present a benchmark of LLM-driven weight-space programming on vision models, in which five LLMs edit convolutional networks and vision transformers on relabeling and error-correction tasks on Waterbirds, CIFAR-100, PACS and Entity-30. We report more than 2,600 such edit processes, whereby each edit is scored on held-out images for success, side effects and accuracy loss. We compare standard training with label smoothing, gradient-based editable training, and our Edit-Ready Training (ERT), a novel method that rehearses the direct, closed-form weight edits LLMs perform. We show that preparing networks for editing raises the success of LLM edits substantially where standard networks are hard to edit. ERT further achieves the highest mean score for GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 across all evaluated baselines. We will release our LLM testing framework alongside all tasks, editing trajectories and scores. Project page: https://viscom.uni-ulm.de/wsp
hf.titleZh: 训练视觉模型以实现LLM驱动的权重空间编程
hf.summaryZh: 针对LLM直接改写神经网络权重的权重空间编程，构建视觉模型基准：五个LLM在Waterbirds、CIFAR-100、PACS和Entity-30上对卷积网络与ViT执行重标注及纠错编辑，记录2600余次编辑，并按成功率、副作用与精度损失评分。比较标准训练、标签平滑、梯度可编辑训练与Edit-Ready Training（ERT），ERT排练LLM的闭式权重编辑。结果，面向编辑的训练能在标准网络难以编辑时提升成功率，ERT在GPT-6 Astra与Claude Opus 5.5上取得最高分。
hf.reason: LLM权重编辑基准，属交叉擦边，分量中等

hf.title: Learning What Actions Change: Action Effect Matching for Dynamics-Faithful World Models
hf.abstract: World models aim to predict environment dynamics under actions, enabling the prediction of action consequences without executing them in the real world. Yet despite producing increasingly realistic videos, current world models often fail to capture how small action changes affect future observations. This limits their use in tasks such as robotic policy evaluation and model-based planning, where nearly identical actions can lead to qualitatively different outcomes. To address this, we propose AFFECT, an auxiliary training objective for learning the distribution of visual changes induced by action perturbations. Specifically, we inject temporally correlated noise into the actions of a policy trained on task-agnostic human teleoperation. We then train the world model so that its generated videos respond to this noise as the recorded videos do, without requiring repeated executions from the same initial state. Across OGBench simulation and real-world DROID and ALOHA-2 setups, AFFECT makes world-model rollouts more faithful to real outcomes. On DROID, the Pearson correlation between policy success rates in the world model and on the real robot rises from 0.47 to 0.79, alongside up to 23% lower FVD. These gains carry over to planning, where selecting actions with AFFECT-trained world models improves task success by up to 8.3%.
hf.titleZh: 学习哪些动作会带来变化:面向动力学忠实的动作效果匹配
hf.summaryZh: 针对世界模型生成的视频虽逼真、却对动作的细微变化不敏感、动力学不忠实的问题，提出辅助训练目标 AFFECT:向基于无任务人类遥操作数据训练的策略动作注入时间相关噪声，要求世界模型生成的视频对该扰动的响应与真实录制视频一致，且无需从同一初始状态重复执行。在 OGBench 仿真与真实 DROID、ALOHA-2 平台上，世界模型的 rollout 更贴近真实结果，DROID 上世界模型内策略成功率与真机成功率的 Pearson 相关从 0.47 升至 0.79,FVD 最多降低 23%;用于基于模型的规划时任务成功率最多提升 8.3%。该工作面向机器人策略评估与想象规划中对动作敏感的世界模型需求。
hf.reason: 世界模型动作敏感性的训练目标，真机验证扎实，命中具身方向

hf.title: WM^MLLM: Turning MLLMs into World Models
hf.abstract: Video world models keep the world in the context of a generator, so a revisit is synthesized again and earlier edits can drift or disappear. We present WM^MLLM, the first interactive world model built on multimodal large language models (MLLMs), for persistent, editable world generation from a single image. WM^MLLM keeps the world state outside every generator, as a panorama with a revision history, and lets the MLLMs write it: they turn each request into operations on this state, select where a local edit is written, and check every candidate before it becomes the next state. Image generators only propose views, and video only presents them. Users can walk to new places and return, edit objects through text or a box, place subjects, and change lighting, weather or season. By construction, a revisit at the same revision reproduces the earlier view exactly, a local edit leaves every panorama pixel outside its region unchanged, and each request starts from the result of the previous one. Against six world model baselines on MBench-A, WM^MLLM has the highest mean on all four environment-recovery metrics (Epipolar 91.5 versus 0.1 to 74.0) and completes the most camera round trips (85.3% versus at most 50.9%). It has the best value in all 15 CompBench columns against 15 baselines. On 112 local edits judged blind, selecting the region to write after generation raises completion from 34.8% to 83.0%. On 258 WBench and MBench-A items, all 46 revisits recover their earlier views, and all 97 local edits that pass the check leave panorama pixels outside their region unchanged.
hf.titleZh: WM^MLLM：把 MLLM 变成世界模型
hf.summaryZh: 视频世界模型把世界状态放在生成器上下文里，重访同一地点需要重新合成，先前的编辑会漂移或消失。WM^MLLM 把世界状态外置为带修订历史的全景图，由 MLLM 将每次请求转成对该状态的操作：决定局部编辑写入的位置并校验候选，图像生成器只提出视角、视频只负责呈现。在 MBench-A 上四项环境恢复指标的均值最高（Epipolar 91.5，基线为 0.1–74.0），完成的相机往返次数最多（85.3% 对至多 50.9%），并在 CompBench 的 15 列全部领先；112 次盲评局部编辑中，先生成候选再选择写入区域将完成率由 34.8% 提升到 83.0%。
hf.reason: 世界模型以 MLLM 调度图像生成，主体仍属视觉生成方向

hf.title: Accelerating Mixture of Block Attention via Dynamic Routing, KV-Centric Execution and Runtime Pipelining
hf.abstract: Mixture of Block Attention (MoBA) reduces long-context computation by selecting key-value (KV) blocks for each query. FlashMoBA implements MoBA efficiently but retains a fixed Top-k budget and query-centric schedule. Fixed Top-k applies one budget across different score distributions and couples routing to task granularity; query-range ownership fragments K/V reuse when several ranges select the same column. We present LightningMoBA, which co-designs selection and execution through dynamic routing, KV-centric ownership, and runtime pipelining. Dynamic routing thresholds MoBA's per-query block scores and directly emits variable-cardinality sparse metadata. KV-centric ownership groups selected rows by (query head, KV block) column, splits high-fanout columns into bounded tasks, and reuses each task's loaded KV tile. On Hopper, pipelining overlaps regular K/V transfers and irregular query gathers with Tensor Core computation. Together, these mechanisms decouple retention from GPU scheduling granularity. At matched Top-16 retention across five checkpoints, LightningMoBA accelerates end-to-end generation by 1.20 to 1.60x while raising mean RULER score from 74.42 to 75.28.
hf.titleZh: 通过动态路由、以 KV 为中心的执行与运行时流水线加速 Mixture of Block Attention
hf.summaryZh: MoBA 靠为每个 query 选取 KV 块来削减长上下文计算，但 FlashMoBA 保留固定 Top-k 预算与 query-centric 调度:同一预算被套用到不同分数分布上、路由与任务粒度耦合，且 query-range 归属让多个 range 选中同一列时 K/V 复用被打碎。LightningMoBA 协同设计选择与执行:对每 query 的块分数做阈值化，直接产出可变基数的稀疏元数据;按(query head,KV block)列做 KV-centric 归属，把高扇出列拆成有界任务并复用其加载的 KV tile;在 Hopper 上以运行时流水线让规则 K/V 传输与不规则 query gather 同 Tensor Core 计算重叠。在五个 checkpoint 上匹配 Top-16 保留率时，端到端生成取得 1.20 至 1.60 倍加速，RULER 均分由 74.42 升至 75.28。
hf.reason: MoBA 长上下文稀疏注意力的系统级优化，命中架构与效率方向

hf.title: AutoMaster: Autonomous Post-Training by Making the Same Model a Better Teacher
hf.abstract: Task success alone does not specify which behaviors post-training should reinforce. Even successful teacher trajectories can contain unsupported assumptions, unproductive repetition, or superficial verification. We propose Skill-FT (Skill-Guided Fine-Tuning), which uses natural-language skills to suppress undesirable habits and elicit underrepresented effective behaviors during teacher rollouts, then fine-tunes a target model on the resulting trajectories. We introduce AutoMaster, an autonomous post-training system in which an LLM agent develops these interventions through trajectory analysis, skill design, data selection, and feedback from rollouts and target-model evaluation. Across Terminal, Search, and software engineering tasks with 4B and 9B target models, AutoMaster improves mean performance over Vanilla SFT on successful unguided teacher trajectories by 1.42-8.99 percentage points, with the teacher, task pool, training set size, and SFT recipe held fixed. Together with the ablations and trajectory analyses, these results suggest that behavioral shaping can make a fixed model a more effective teacher. We further find that retaining skill instructions during SFT yields higher mean performance than removing them across all six settings, despite their absence at evaluation and identical supervised outputs. These findings suggest that preserving skill context as part of a training demonstration can support better behavioral internalization.
hf.titleZh: AutoMaster:让同一模型成为更好的教师，实现自主后训练
hf.summaryZh: 任务成功率本身并不能指明后训练应强化哪些行为，成功的教师轨迹里也可能混有臆断、无效重复与浅层验证。Skill-FT 用自然语言技能描述抑制这些不良习惯、激发教师 rollout 中原本不足的有效行为，再在由此得到的轨迹上微调目标模型;AutoMaster 则让一个 LLM agent 通过轨迹分析、技能设计、数据选择以及 rollout 与目标模型评估的反馈，自动完成上述干预的开发。在 Terminal、Search 与软件工程任务上，目标模型为 4B 与 9B 时，在教师、任务池、训练集规模与 SFT 配方均固定的条件下，AutoMaster 相比在未引导的成功教师轨迹上做普通 SFT，平均性能提升 1.42–8.99 个百分点;且在全部六个设置中，SFT 时保留技能指令比去掉指令取得更高的平均性能，尽管评估时并无技能指令、监督输出完全相同，说明把技能上下文保留在训练示范中有助于更好的行为内化。
hf.reason: 自主后训练+SFT 行为塑造，直接命中后训练方向

hf.title: On-Policy Morphing into Hybrid Attention Models
hf.abstract: Hybrid attention models combine full and linear attention to achieve a better quality--efficiency trade-off. Converting pretrained Transformers into such models requires identifying which layers should retain full attention under a prescribed budget. We identify two off-policy mismatches in FlashMorph's layer selection: (i) continuous branch interpolation and teacher-forced hidden states differ from discrete hybrid computation; and (ii) frozen model weights fail to account for parameter adaptation during subsequent recovery. We introduce FlashMorph2, an on-policy layer-selection method that (I) evaluates sampled discrete hybrid architectures end to end using their own hidden states, and (II) jointly optimizes layer-selection scores and model weights under the recovery objective to reflect post-adaptation performance. Experiments across Qwen3 model scales and linear-attention variants show that FlashMorph2 consistently outperforms existing layer-selection methods, improving average scores over FlashMorph by +2.42 points on RULER, +1.08 on LongBench, and +0.76 on recall-intensive tasks, while completing layer selection in only 0.72--3.57 GPU hours across 0.6B--8B models, demonstrating high efficiency and scalability.
hf.titleZh: 以 On-Policy 方式改造为混合注意力模型
hf.summaryZh: 把预训练 Transformer 转成全注意力与线性注意力混合的架构，关键在于在给定预算下选出哪些层保留全注意力。现有 FlashMorph 的层选择存在两处 off-policy 失配:连续分支插值与 teacher-forcing 隐状态偏离离散混合计算，冻结权重也忽略了后续恢复训练中的参数适配。FlashMorph2 改为 on-policy:端到端评测采样出的离散混合架构、用其自身隐状态，并在恢复目标下联合优化层选择分数与模型权重。在 Qwen3 各规模与多种线性注意力变体上，它稳定优于既有层选择方法，RULER 平均分较 FlashMorph 提升 2.42、LongBench 提升 1.08、召回密集型任务提升 0.76，且 0.6B–8B 模型仅需 0.72–3.57 GPU 小时完成层选择。
hf.reason: 混合注意力架构转换与层选择，正击架构与长上下文方向

hf.title: Online Mistake Detection in Instruction-Conditioned Procedural Video
hf.abstract: An assistant monitoring a person performing a procedure is most useful when it can detect mistakes while there is still time to recover. This requires judging actions against task instructions as the video unfolds, identifying the attempted step, locating it in time, and assessing its execution. Existing online detectors do not use the instruction text, while instruction-conditioned methods operate offline. In this paper, we study online, instruction-conditioned mistake detection in egocentric videos. Using only observed video, task instructions, and prior predictions, our model identifies and localizes completed action attempts and classifies them as correct, modified, slip, corrections, or additions; omitted steps are determined after the video ends. We compare a modular pipeline, with separate step identification, temporal localization, and execution verification, to a joint model that predicts all outputs in a single step. To support supervised learning from mistakes, we repartition EgoPER to include erroneous videos in all splits. The approaches achieve similar step-segmentation F1@0.5 (93.6% and 92.1%), while the joint model achieves higher binary mistake-detection F1@0.5 (84.1% vs. 80.7%), with its largest gain on slips (56.4% vs. 37.5%). Component-level analysis suggests that error propagation between stages contributes to the modular approach's lower detection score. On test videos containing mistakes, both designs outperform released AEM and ESTANet checkpoints under our evaluation protocol.
hf.titleZh: 指令条件下操作流程视频的在线错误检测
hf.summaryZh: 监测操作流程时，助理需要在错误仍可挽回的阶段即时判定动作是否符合任务指令。该工作研究第一视角视频下的在线指令条件错误检测:仅利用已观测视频、任务指令和先前预测，识别并定位已完成的动作尝试，分类为正确、修改、失误、纠正或多余动作，遗漏步骤在视频结束后判定;并对比分模块流水线(步骤识别、时间定位、执行核验)与单步联合预测模型，同时重新划分EgoPER数据集使各子集均含错误视频。结果显示两者步骤分割F1@0.5相近(93.6%与92.1%)，联合模型二分类错误检测F1@0.5更高(84.1%对80.7%)，在失误(slip)类别增益最大(56.4%对37.5%);分模块方案的误差在阶段间传播导致检测得分偏低，两个设计在含错误的测试视频上均优于已发布的AEM与ESTANet检查点。
hf.reason: 第一视角操作视频错误检测，属视频理解与垂直应用，与LLM关注点无关

hf.title: Twice-Told Critiques: Claim-Level Homogenization of Peer Review in the LLM Era
hf.abstract: Peer review relies on several readers finding different problems. We measure critique overlap in conference and journal reviews. At ICLR, measured overlap rose from 12.0% in 2026 to 21.3% in 2027, in reviews from the same stage of the review process, with year-on-year rises at NeurIPS, ICML and the F1000 and PLOS journals. A third ICLR review of a paper added 5.46 new problems to the other two in 2027, against 6.12 in 2026. We apply MELD, a detector of LLM-generated text, to all reviews. Within a paper, two reviews that MELD flags overlap more than two unflagged reviews: by 3.0 points at ICLR in 2024-2025, by 4.5 points in 2026-2027, and by 5.4 points across five journal sources. These results provide evidence that LLM-flagged reviews of one paper are less distinct from each other than unflagged reviews, and suggest that the diversity of critiques among reviews of a single paper is falling.
hf.titleZh: 双重讲述的评审意见：LLM 时代同行评审在论断层面的同质化
hf.summaryZh: 同行评审依赖多位审稿人各自发现不同问题，而 LLM 撰写的审稿意见可能让批评趋同。该工作在会议与期刊审稿中测量论断层面的批评重叠率，并用 LLM 生成文本检测器 MELD 标记审稿。ICLR 同一评审阶段的测得的重叠率从 2026 年的 12.0% 升至 2027 年的 21.3%，NeurIPS、ICML 及 F1000、PLOS 期刊也同比上升；2027 年第三篇 ICLR 审稿相对前两篇仅新增 5.46 个问题，2026 年为 6.12。同一论文中被标记为 LLM 生成的两篇审稿重叠度高于两篇未标记审稿，ICLR 2024–2025 高 3.0 个百分点、2026–2027 高 4.5 个百分点、五家期刊来源平均高 5.4 个百分点。结果提示 LLM 参与的审稿在单篇论文内批评多样性下降，对评审质量与学术把关具有警示意义。
hf.reason: LLM 审稿同质化的测量研究，属评测方法学擦边，选题有趣但分量有限

hf.title: Language Models Can Rewrite Their Own Weights
hf.abstract: Language models are trained once, frozen and deployed: improving one again takes another training run, and a prompt, a scaffold or extra computation at inference is gone once the task ends. A frontier model has been shown to edit the weights of a much smaller one. We ask whether a model can rewrite its own weights to make itself better, and find that it can, by its own reasoning, with no gradients and no training; we call this self-rewriting. Given its weights, graded answers and the ability to run itself, a 27B model diagnoses its failure and edits the weights behind it. It surpasses itself: its own edit makes it 6.6 points more accurate on 490 problems it never saw, in a test fixed in advance, and another session's edit also makes it significantly better. It keeps getting better: it submits an edit only when its own tests support it, each edit replacing the last, and over its first eight such sessions its accuracy only rises. Unlike test-time scaling, the gain persists in its weights and adds no cost per answer; unlike training, it needs no pre- or post-training infrastructure, only an open model and hours on one GPU. It repairs a damaged copy of itself: it locates the corrupted matrix and rewrites it with values of its own, never reading the undamaged weights; found on text math problems alone, the repair lifts the copy on six image benchmarks it never saw from 7% to 70% accuracy, 83% of the undamaged model's. And the ability emerges with scale: across four sizes of one family, the 2B model makes no edit and the 4B and 9B models break themselves; only the 27B model works on itself as a human would, comparing its hidden states on answers that finish and on answers that run out of tokens, weakening the direction that separates them. Like a human, a model need not separate training from inference; improving a language model may come to take a conversation rather than a training run.
hf.titleZh: 语言模型能重写自己的权重
hf.summaryZh: 模型部署后权重冻结，改进只能靠再训练，推理期的提示与脚手架在任务结束后即消失。论文提出self‑rewriting：给定自身权重、带评分的答案与运行自身的能力，27B模型自行诊断失败原因并直接改写对应权重，无需梯度与训练，仅在自测通过时提交编辑并逐次替换。在事先固定的490道未见题上准确率提升6.6分，前八次编辑会话中准确率单调上升；对损坏副本，仅凭文本数学题定位并重写受损矩阵，便把六个未见图像基准从7%提升到70%（达未损坏模型的83%）。该能力随规模涌现：2B不做编辑，4B与9B自我破坏，仅27B可行，提示改进LLM或将从一次训练变为一次对话。
hf.reason: 免梯度自我改写权重，直接命中自改进与后训练方向

hf.title: CompoundingKernel: Self-Improving from Zero to First
hf.abstract: We present CompoundingKernel, a self-improving agent system that writes GPU kernels by search. As of 2026-11-11, its generated kernels rank #1 on the public L1, L2 and Quantization boards of SOL-ExecBench (NVIDIA B200). They have held #1 on L1 since 2026-10-27, albeit a short loss on 2026-11-07. All 235 problems have a site-verified correct kernel; on the 209 public-board problems they are 4.40x faster than the benchmark's reference baseline. The search starts from zero: agents get each problem's PyTorch definition but no reference kernels or official scores. A per-problem archive outside the model holds every correct kernel and its lineage. An LLM controller reads it, picks a parent or a new design, and gives each parallel child agent one direction. Checks outside the model decide correctness. At equal wall time, it beat a coded UCB style tree on 35 of 38 problems by making 2.4x as many correct attempts. Over a thousand agents ran at once, and one warm restart fix raised their evaluation rate 3.6x. We find that the rate of reliable measurements, not the number of agents, limits how far such a search scales. Our code and kernels are available on URL.
hf.titleZh: CompoundingKernel：从零到第一的自我改进
hf.summaryZh: 从零开始搜索生成 GPU kernel 的自改进智能体系统：每题只给 PyTorch 定义，不给参考 kernel 与官方分数；模型外的档案库保存所有正确 kernel 及其谱系，LLM 控制器据此选父代或新设计，并给每个并行子智能体指定单一方向，正确性由模型外检查判定。在 SOL-ExecBench（NVIDIA B200）上，235 题均有站点验证的正确 kernel，209 道公开题平均比参考基线快 4.40 倍，L1、L2 与量化榜均列第一。等墙钟时间下对 UCB 式树搜索在 38 题中胜 35 题，正确尝试数为 2.4 倍；超千智能体并行时一次热重启修复把评测速率提到 3.6 倍，表明瓶颈在可靠测量速率而非智能体数量。
hf.reason: Agent 搜索自动写 GPU kernel，自改进加系统效率，结果扎实

hf.title: Embeddings vs. Grep: Rethinking the Dense Advantage in Code Search
hf.abstract: Code-search benchmarks show dense encoders well ahead of BM25, yet coding agents do well with grep. What does this dense advantage measure? Existing benchmarks cannot tell: they use curated queries, old code and a handicapped BM25. To find out, we build Repo-Premium, a realistic repository-level code-search benchmark. It ranks files in real repositories, with curated and raw queries in Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, Go, Rust and Java, pull requests from 2022 to 2026, and a preregistered test pool over 91 repositories. Our experiments trace the advantage to two sources: evaluation choices that favor dense retrieval, such as splitting files into chunks for BM25 and counting edited tests as relevant, and queries that lack the code's rare identifiers. Expanding the query with LLM-written identifiers (generate-then-grep) helps BM25 far more than dense retrieval, letting it match dense retrieval in every Python pool, even on pull requests opened after the LLM was released. No method we tried predicts which retriever will win on a given query. From these results we derive three guidelines: measure dense gains against a fair lexical baseline, fuse dense retrieval with BM25, and add the code's words to queries that lack them.
hf.titleZh: 嵌入 vs. Grep：重审代码搜索中的稠密优势
hf.summaryZh: 代码搜索基准显示稠密编码器远超 BM25，但编程 Agent 用 grep 也表现良好，这一「稠密优势」究竟测的是什么？为此构建 Repo-Premium：真实仓库级代码检索基准，覆盖 Python、JavaScript、TypeScript、Go、Rust、Java 六种语言，使用 2022–2026 年的 pull request 与 curated/raw 两类查询，并在 91 个仓库上预注册测试池。实验把优势归因于两点：偏向稠密检索的评测选择（如把文件切块后喂给 BM25、把被修改的测试算作相关），以及查询缺少代码中的稀有标识符。用 LLM 生成标识符扩展查询（generate-then-grep）对 BM25 的提升远大于稠密检索，使其在每个 Python 测试池上追平稠密检索，包括 LLM 发布之后才开启的 PR；但没有方法能预测单条查询上哪种检索器会胜出。据此提出三条准则：以公平的词法基线衡量稠密增益、将稠密检索与 BM25 融合、为缺少代码词汇的查询补词。
hf.reason: 代码检索评测方法学，属代码智能与评测擦边，非后训练核心

hf.title: System 1 agents: a method for local, reliable and fast agentic AI
hf.abstract: Agentic artificial intelligence could automate analyses of sensitive clinical data, but current agents depend on large language models (LLMs). Cloud LLMs expose patient data. Local LLMs hallucinate, and an invented value in a tool call propagates through every later step. Here we present a method to build System 1 agents: local agents that call tools without generating text. A deterministic compiler turns each tool's schema and the request into multiple-choice questions whose options come from the request and the schema, then a one-pass decision model answers them. On 1,952 requests to 157 biomedical tools, the best System 1 agent chose the right tool, or correctly declined, for 97.0% of requests, significantly ahead of all 18 local LLM-agent settings (best 95.2%). The System 1 agent filled 97.0% of 6,056 stated argument values. No System 1 call contained invented content, against 5.5-19.7% of LLM calls. The System 1 Agents framework is freely available as open-source software at https://github.com/eltzanis/SystemOneAgents.
hf.titleZh: System 1 智能体:一种本地、可靠、快速的智能体 AI 方法
hf.summaryZh: 在敏感数据场景中，本地智能体受限于 LLM 幻觉:工具调用里编造的参数值会沿后续步骤传播。该工作用确定性编译器把每个工具的 schema 与请求编译成多选题，选项只取自请求与 schema，再由一次前向的决策模型作答，全程不生成自由文本。在 157 个生物医学工具、1952 条请求上，最佳 System 1 智能体正确选择工具或正确拒答的比例达 97.0%，高于 18 种本地 LLM 智能体配置中最好的 95.2%;在 6056 个已声明参数值上填充率 97.0%，且无一次调用出现编造内容，而 LLM 调用为 5.5%–19.7%。框架已开源，适用于临床等数据不可出域的可靠工具调用部署。
hf.reason: 以非生成式决策模型替代 LLM 完成工具调用，属 Agent 工具调用方向的扎实工作

hf.title: VSpark: Speculative Decoding for Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action Models
hf.abstract: Our aim is to accelerate autoregressive vision-language-action models (VLAs), which generate robot actions one token at a time. Speculative decoding makes this possible: a lightweight draft model proposes several tokens at once, and the VLA verifies them in a single pass, accepting only those that match its own predictions, so decoding remains lossless. The speedup, however, is limited in robot control, where many different tokens encode nearly the same motion and a draft close to the correct action is still rejected. To address this, our approach, VSpark, is built upon three design choices: (i) rollouts collected with calibrated action noise, which expose the draft to a wider range of robot states; (ii) feature alignment, which trains the draft to match the VLA's hidden features rather than its output tokens alone; and (iii) continuation reuse, which keeps the predictions the VLA has already computed along rejected drafts as candidates for the next verification step, instead of discarding them. On four VLAs with different action tokenizers and four manipulation benchmarks, VSpark achieves 1.28x to 2.10x speedup while keeping the VLA's decoding lossless.
hf.titleZh: VSpark：面向自回归视觉-语言-动作模型的推测解码
hf.summaryZh: 针对自回归VLA逐token生成动作导致推理慢的问题，将无损的推测解码引入机器人控制；但动作空间中许多不同token编码近乎相同的运动，draft即使接近正确动作仍会被拒绝。VSpark由此做三点设计：用带校准动作噪声的rollout让draft覆盖更广的机器人状态；用特征对齐让draft匹配VLA的隐特征而非仅拟合输出token；用continuation reuse保留被拒draft上VLA已算出的预测作为下一轮验证候选，而非丢弃。在4个采用不同动作tokenizer的VLA与4个操作基准上取得1.28×至2.10×加速，且解码保持无损。
hf.reason: VLA推测解码加速，机制有新意、实验扎实

hf.title: Teaching Vision-Language-Action Models to Stop Safely
hf.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable robots to perform diverse tasks from visual observations and language instructions. While prior work has explored task suppression and refusal, stopping prohibited behavior once execution is underway and controlling the resulting physical response remain challenging. Our evaluation reveals that policies which suppress a task from its initial state can still complete it when taking over partway through execution. Even when the task remains unfinished, the robot may drop a held object, making non-completion an incomplete measure of safety. To address these challenges, we introduce State-Aware Fallback Imitation (SAFI) for tasks where holding provides an appropriate alternative response. SAFI comprises two stages, (1) fallback target construction, which assigns stationary arm commands and consistent gripper targets throughout prohibited-task demonstrations, and (2) joint policy adaptation, which learns these targets alongside the original actions of retained tasks. This supervision teaches an explicit alternative response at intermediate execution states while maintaining the robot's other skills. Extensive experiments with OpenVLA-OFT across LIBERO and BadLIBERO tasks evaluate prohibited completion, physical incidents, and retained-task performance. On the evaluated LIBERO tasks, SAFI reduces aggregate target success after takeover to 1.3\%, with no recorded physical incidents or action saturation, while preserving high retained-task success.
hf.titleZh: 教会视觉-语言-动作模型安全停止
hf.summaryZh: 现有VLA策略在任务执行中途被接管时仍可能完成被禁止任务，甚至掉落手中物体，仅以“未完成”衡量安全并不充分。SAFI分两阶段：在禁止任务示范中构造静止手臂与一致夹爪的回退目标，再将回退目标与保留任务动作联合训练，使模型在中间执行状态学会显式替代响应。基于OpenVLA-OFT在LIBERO与BadLIBERO上的实验显示，接管后目标成功率降至1.3%，无物理事故与动作饱和，保留任务成功率保持较高。
hf.reason: VLA安全停止与后训练，直接命中具身安全方向

hf.title: A CPU Inside an LLM: Zero-Gradient Compilation of Exact Circuits into Pretrained Weights
hf.abstract: Pretrained language models (LMs) remain unreliable on exact multi-digit arithmetic without gradient fine-tuning or external tool interpreters. We introduce closed-form, zero-gradient circuit-grafting primitives that compile deterministic computation directly into pretrained LM weights using zero training examples and zero runtime hooks, while bounding per-layer normalization drift and preserving natural-language (NL) competence. Our construction combines three analytical mechanisms: (1) two-layer Mellin-GLU quadrature over bias-free SwiGLU/GeGLU layers, turning unknown per-token RMSNorm scaling into translation along a log-spaced gate grid (>250times dynamic range) with IEEE 754 error bounds; (2) cross-token scale cancellation via signed Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE self-sink attention and memoryless SiLU-antisymmetric GatedDeltaNet shifts; and (3) axis-aligned width extension (d to d+K) with d/(d+K) norm compensation, Base-1000 canonical BPE emission, and differential (+254,-256) tied unembeddings. An automated 5-stage compiler synthesizes 4-8 digit signed {+,-,times} circuits in constant TC^0 depth alongside 3-literal Boolean (100%, N=1{,}728; plus 42-layer Gemma 4 E4B audits) and 5-bit Majority/Parity (100%) circuits. On 6-digit arithmetic (N=1{,}200, BF16), IBM Granite 4.2 3B (1.07M-1.33M active non-zeros, le 0.036%) and Alibaba Qwen 3.5 4B (2.25M-2.39M non-zeros, le 0.057%) reach 99.17% and 100.00% ALU-prefix accuracy (100% with an FP32 sidecar) and 98%-100% mid-sentence resumption, outperforming 12.8K-sample LoRA (42.2% / 61.7%, 0% inline continuation). A factorized block-sparse sidecar holds A100 memory at 7.89 / 10.65 GiB (4.60 / 8.14 GiB under INT8/INT4 + FP32 sidecar) while passing all 14/14 pre-registered >2K-token Tango splits (N=4{,}392; 0/11,134 OOD triggers).
hf.titleZh: LLM 中的 CPU：把精确电路零梯度编译进预训练权重
hf.summaryZh: 预训练语言模型的多位数精确算术仍不可靠，通常依赖梯度微调或外部工具。该工作提出零梯度、闭式的电路移植原语，把确定性计算直接编译进预训练权重：以Mellin-GLU求积吸收RMSNorm缩放、用Chebyshev Indefinite-RoPE与GatedDeltaNet完成跨token尺度消解，并借助宽度扩展与Base-1000 BPE输出，无需训练样本或运行时钩子。在6位数算术上，Granite 4.2 3B与Qwen 3.5 4B分别达到99.17%与100.00%的ALU前缀准确率，远超12.8K样本LoRA的42.2%/61.7%，且仅改动不到0.06%参数。
hf.reason: 零梯度权重编译实现精确算术，方法新颖、实验扎实，命中LLM架构与效率方向

arxiv.title: MemOnce: A Scalable Memory Architecture for Large Language Models
arxiv.abstract: Deploying large language models (LLMs) in long-horizon and continual interactions requires maintaining reusable memory states for future inference, posing challenges for existing architectures. Standard Transformers accumulate layer-wise, token-level KV caches, incurring linear GPU memory growth and quadratic computational complexity as the context expands. In contrast, linear-time architectures compress history into fixed-size states, but struggle to retain fine-grained details. We introduce MemOnce, a foundation architecture that learns scalable memory states for language models. MemOnce is based on two core designs: (a) Memory encoder-decoder: it caches only a small subset of final-layer hidden states as compact memory representations and dynamically decodes them back into KV caches for attention layers; (b) Memory sparse attention: for each continual input, MemOnce adaptively retrieves relevant memory representations, with the sparse indices computed only once across layers. Coupling these two designs enables efficient on-the-fly memory loading and KV cache decoding, drastically reducing the GPU memory footprint and achieving linear-time complexity. We conduct extensive experiments to show that MemOnce outperforms Transformers and other architectures across varying model sizes, context lengths, and training paradigms (pretraining and post-training adaptation). In particular, adapting Qwen3.5-4B with MemOnce reduces memory state cache by 1313$\times$ and prefill latency by 6.9$\times$ at 1M context, and improves throughput by 3.5$\times$ and overall memory performance by +5.77%. Finally, MemOnce generalizes zero-shot to downstream representation tasks, achieving competitive results against specialized models.
arxiv.titleZh: MemOnce:面向大语言模型的可扩展记忆架构
arxiv.summaryZh: 标准Transformer随上下文增长累积逐层token级KV cache，显存线性膨胀、计算量二次方增长;线性时间架构虽将历史压缩为固定状态，却难以保留细粒度细节。MemOnce只缓存最后一层少量隐状态作为紧凑记忆表示，并动态解码回各注意力层的KV cache，同时为每段连续输入自适应检索相关记忆，稀疏索引跨层仅计算一次。适配Qwen3.5-4B后，在1M上下文下记忆状态缓存降低1313倍、prefill延迟降低6.9倍，吞吐提升3.5倍，整体记忆性能提升5.77%，并可零样本泛化到下游表示任务。
arxiv.reason: 新记忆架构，直接针对长上下文KV cache与线性复杂度

arxiv.title: Model Carving: Training Transformers That Optimize Their Own Topology
arxiv.abstract: Machine learning has largely kept separate the choice of architecture and the process of training. A classic Transformer, for instance, trains a fixed set of attention and MLP sublayers at every layer, in the same order, and optimizes the weights within. This uniformity is a convention rather than a principled design choice, and it is likely suboptimal: the best architecture for a given task may be smaller, more efficient, and far from uniform. We believe that, ideally, training itself should shape the model's topology. To this end, we introduce Model Carving, which learns both a Transformer's weights and its architecture in a single run. By applying learnable, scalar gates to each sublayer, we allow the training loss to remove the model's own components during training -- freeing a smaller heterogeneous network inside. We evaluate Model Carving by pre-training standard Transformers from 140M to 2.7B parameters and looped Transformers from 140M to 1.3B. At equal training compute, carved models reach a lower validation loss than dense models trained with up to 1.7 times more compute. Furthermore, carved models also outperform size-matched models produced by pruning or distillation, suggesting that the best way to obtain small models for edge devices is to carve them during training, not to compress a large one afterwards. This advantage both grows with scale and carries over to downstream tasks such as few-shot evaluation and generation. Because the removed sublayers no longer run, carved models also cost up to 34% fewer FLOPs per token and decode up to 1.6 times faster without cost in quality. Our results show that architecture, like weights, should be learned and not fixed in advance, and that inside every large transformer is a smaller, faster, stronger one waiting to be carved out.

arxiv.titleZh: 模型雕刻：训练能优化自身拓扑的 Transformer
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 Transformer 各层按同一顺序堆叠同一组注意力与 MLP 子层这一约定式设计，提出 Model Carving：给每个子层加上可学习的标量门控，让训练损失在预训练过程中直接移除模型自身的组件，从而得到一个更小、异构的子网络。在 140M–2.7B 标准 Transformer 与 140M–1.3B 循环 Transformer 上预训练，等训练算力下雕刻模型的验证损失低于用至多 1.7 倍算力训练的稠密模型，并优于同尺寸的剪枝与蒸馏模型，且优势随规模增大并迁移到少样本评测与生成任务。被移除的子层不再参与计算，每 token FLOPs 最多降低 34%，解码提速至多 1.6 倍而质量无损。结果表明架构应像权重一样在训练中学习而非预先固定，为端侧小模型提供了「训练时雕刻」而非「事后压缩」的新路径。
arxiv.reason: 预训练中学习架构拓扑，命中架构与效率方向，实验扎实

arxiv.title: Bel: Step-Level Policy Improvement of Visual Agents Without Training
arxiv.abstract: A visual agent acts on what it sees: it taps and types on a screen, or points on a camera image to show a robot where to act. One wrong step can fail its task, yet the right action is often among its own samples, passed over by its greedy decode. Choosing it is a visual judgment, since an action is best judged where it acts, not by its text or coordinates alone: as text, a tap is two numbers; drawn on the screen, it is the Post button of an empty draft. We find that this is decisive: given the screenshot and a tap's coordinates, a decision model chooses among GUI-R1-3B's samples significantly worse on average than when the tap is drawn where it lands. Bel turns this finding into a method that trains nothing and needs only a frozen policy's samples and an image on which each action can be drawn. It marks each candidate on its own copy of the image it acts on, asks a decision model for the probability that executing it is the right decision, so that every kind of action shares one scale, and acts on another candidate only when greedy scores below a threshold and trails it by a margin. On recorded GUI steps, for each of three policies, Bel significantly beats greedy decoding on mobile, web and desktop screens alike and, on the same candidates, gives each a significantly higher mean step success than voting, CATTS, the trained GUI-Critic-R1 and two prompted Qwen3-VL judges shown the same marks; it also significantly improves the much larger Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B on every step-level test set. With GUI-R1-3B's thresholds unchanged, Bel significantly raises live AndroidWorld and MiniWoB++ task success for two other policies and robot-pointing success for three policies on each of two groups of benchmarks. Judging each action where it acts thus gives step-level policy improvement of visual agents without training, with significant gains for GUI agents and robot pointing.
arxiv.titleZh: Bel：无需训练的可视化 Agent 步级策略改进
arxiv.summaryZh: 可视化 Agent（GUI 点击、机器人指向）的单步错误就可能导致任务失败，而正确动作往往就在策略自身的采样里，却被贪心解码略过。Bel 发现：把候选动作（如点击坐标）直接画在其作用的截图上再让决策模型评判，比只给文本坐标判断准确得多。方法无需训练，只用一个冻结策略的采样、一个对每个候选动作各自标注的图像副本和一个决策模型，计算各候选动作被执行即正确的概率，使不同类型的动作共享同一尺度，并在贪心分数低于阈值且落后领先候选一定幅度时才切换动作。在三个策略的录制 GUI 步骤上，Bel 在移动端、网页与桌面均显著优于贪心解码，步级平均成功率也高于投票、CATTS、训练过的 GUI-Critic-R1 与两个 Qwen3-VL 提示评判器；在 AndroidWorld、MiniWoB++ 上显著提升任务成功率，并在多组基准上提升机器人指向成功率。
arxiv.reason: 无需训练的可视化 Agent 步级策略改进，方法新颖，实验系统全面

arxiv.title: Topology Hub Optimal Transport: Eliminating Long Context Dilution at Flash Speed
arxiv.abstract: Long-context models use sparse or structured attention to avoid quadratic cost, yet retrieving a small set of relevant facts embedded among hundreds of thousands of distractors degrades as normalization mass disperses with length. Hub-and-spoke optimal transport (OT) replaces the dense $L \times L$ matrix with a linear-size graph over local windows and $K$ shared hubs balanced by Sinkhorn scaling. Building on block-wise tail refinement and fixed-support transport topology (arXiv:2605.08123, arXiv:2609.07954), we introduce Topology Hub Optimal Transport (THOT): (1) bounded-support capacity gating via simplex sparsemax ($O(L\log L)$) or sorting-free token-local thresholded ReLU ($O(L)$), driving excess distractor mass to zero; (2) a three-sweep $1+2$ annealed row-closed Sinkhorn schedule that damps bipartite residuals; (3) an exact rank-$(D+2R+1)$ One-Reference-Tile adjoint in batched split-factor Triton kernels (BF16 Tensor Cores, FP32 potentials); and (4) a chunked exclusive-prefix causal variant with verified zero future leakage. On NVIDIA L4, sparsemax THOT trained at $L=128$ reaches 97.40% zero-shot recall of fixed bindings at $L=262{,}144$ under pure task loss ($α=0$) and 98.83% at $α=0.05$ (matched by $O(L)$ thresholded ReLU at $α=0.05$, vs. 80.60% at $α=0$), while softmax-gated hub OT drops to 3.52%. In bidirectional operator microbenchmarks, our kernel runs forward+VJP in 100.1 ms at $H=8, D=64, L=262\mathrm{K}$ (2.2x faster with 4.0x smaller compiler temporaries than latent softmax) and 1.34 ms vs. 4.37 ms for cuDNN FlashAttention at $L=4{,}096$; multi-layer LM runs use the unfused path. Zero-shot WikiText-103 multi-needle retrieval hits 100.00% (128/128 queries at $L=65\mathrm{K}$) vs. 0.78% for short-trained RoPE FlashAttention, and compact 4-layer WikiText-4K runs show modest causal and masked LM gains.
arxiv.titleZh: 拓扑枢纽最优传输：以 Flash 速度消除长上下文稀释
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对长上下文里归一化质量随长度扩散、关键事实被海量干扰项稀释的问题，用「局部窗口 + K 个共享枢纽」的线性规模图替代稠密 L×L 注意力，并以 Sinkhorn 缩放平衡。关键设计是 simplex sparsemax 或无排序阈值 ReLU 的有界支撑容量门控、三趟退火行闭合 Sinkhorn 调度、秩 (D+2R+1) exact adjoint 的 Triton 分块核。在 L4 上以 L=128 训练、L=262,144 零样本召回 97.40%（α=0.05 时 98.83%），softmax 门控版本仅 3.52%；L=4096 处前向加 VJP 为 1.34 ms，cuDNN FlashAttention 为 4.37 ms。
arxiv.reason: 长上下文稀疏注意力新架构加 Triton 内核实现，直接命中架构与效率方向

arxiv.title: DPMA: Learning to Compress Mixture-of-Experts Models
arxiv.abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures offer high computational efficiency, but storing all experts requires substantial memory and limits deployment on resource-constrained hardware. Most retraining-free MoE compression methods commit to either pruning or merging experts, often with a uniform compression ratio across layers. We introduce DPMA (Differentiable Prune Merge Absorb), which jointly learns compression operations and layer-wise expert allocation through gradient descent under a global expert budget. Separate learnable coefficients allow DPMA to prune experts, merge their parameters, and absorb their routing contributions by forwarding routing weights to retained experts. These coefficients and expert assignments are optimised to match the original model's outputs on calibration data while its weights remain frozen. Across four MoE models, eight multiple-choice benchmarks, and five compression ratios, DPMA achieves the highest accuracy averaged over benchmarks and compression ratios on each model among the evaluated methods. At $75\%$ expert reduction, it outperforms the strongest baseline on every model, with gains of up to $6.7$ percentage points.
arxiv.titleZh: DPMA:学习压缩专家混合模型
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 MoE 模型专家存储开销大、多数免重训压缩方法只能在剪枝或合并且各层统一压缩率之间二选一的问题，提出可微分剪枝—合并—吸收框架 DPMA:在全局专家预算约束下，用独立可学习系数同时决定每层保留的专家数，并对被删专家分别执行剪枝、参数合并，或将其路由权重转交给保留专家以吸收路由贡献;系数与专家分配在冻结原模型权重的前提下，以校准数据上的输出匹配为目标做梯度优化。在四个 MoE 模型、八个多项选择基准和五种压缩率上，DPMA 在各模型上的平均准确率均为最高;专家减少 75% 时，在每个模型上都优于最强基线，最大领先 6.7 个百分点。该工作为资源受限场景下的 MoE 免重训部署提供了统一的可学习压缩方案。
arxiv.reason: MoE 免重训压缩，可微分剪枝合并与分层预算，命中高效推理方向

arxiv.title: Belief-State Management Meets Rubric Rewards for Agentic Forecasting
arxiv.abstract: Current large language model (LLM) agents still struggle to forecast real-world events. This stems from two primary limitations: i) standard ReAct harness accumulates reasoning and evidence within one growing context, and ii) outcome-based rewards in forecasting lead to a slow and noisy signal that cannot distinguish sound reasoning from lucky guesses. To address these, we introduce a forecasting training framework including harness design and post-training. For the harness side, we propose Proactive Belief-State Management (PBM), equipping agents with a fold tool to compress lengthy context into compact belief states and reset the context for subsequent exploration. For the training side, we develop SEIPH, a five-dimensional, outcome-blind rubric, providing process-quality rewards. Using the rubric-based reward, we post-train a 35B model with PPO and GRPO, yielding DeepForecaster-PPO and DeepForecaster-GRPO. Theoretically, we prove that idealized fold-based stopping converges and calibrated local rewards reduce segment-level gradient variance. Empirically, DeepForecaster-PPO (35B) achieves the best Brier score on both ForecastBench and Polymarket-Sim, outperforming frontier agents based on DeepSeek-V4-Pro (1.6T), Kimi-K2.6 (1T), and GPT-5.5. DeepForecaster-GRPO ranks second on both FutureX metrics. Ablations reveal that PBM also improves the untrained base model without any training. Calibration analysis shows that DeepForecaster-PPO makes more accurate high-confidence predictions than Qwen3.6 and GPT-5.5. Trajectory analysis further shows that forecasts generally improve from the first to the final belief state as agents gather evidence and revise their judgments.
arxiv.titleZh: 信念状态管理与评分量规奖励结合的智能体预测
arxiv.summaryZh: 针对 LLM agent 预测真实事件的两处瓶颈:ReAct 式单上下文持续膨胀，以及结果型奖励信号慢且噪声大、无法区分严谨推理与侥幸猜中。方法上，用 Proactive Belief-State Management 给 agent 配备 fold 工具，把冗长上下文压缩成紧凑信念状态并重置上下文继续探索;训练侧设计五维、结果盲的 SEIPH 评分量规提供过程质量奖励，以 PPO 与 GRPO 后训练 35B 模型得到 DeepForecaster-PPO/GRPO。35B 的 PPO 版本在 ForecastBench 与 Polymarket-Sim 上取得最佳 Brier score，优于基于 DeepSeek-V4-Pro(1.6T)、Kimi-K2.6(1T)与 GPT-5.5 的 agent,GRPO 版在 FutureX 两项指标居第二。理论上证明理想化 fold 停止收敛、校准的局部奖励可降低 segment 级梯度方差;消融显示 PBM 不训练也能提升基座模型。
arxiv.reason: Agentic RL 加过程 rubric 奖励，直接命中后训练与 Agent 方向

arxiv.title: CreditFilter: Calibrated Token Weights over the Within-Response Entropy Rank for RLVR
arxiv.abstract: Critic-free reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically assigns a uniform advantage to every token. Token-reweighting heuristics like the 80/20 mask favor high-entropy tokens, but fail to measure a token's actual impact on the outcome. We formalize this impact as the forking value: the variance of the success probability over the policy's next-token choices. The expected forking values along a response sum exactly to the reward variance. Token credit is thus, in expectation over a prompt's responses, a fixed budget spent at the forks. This motivates weights that redistribute credit within a response. The forking value factorizes into a fork consequence, which requires costly continuations to estimate, and a fork probability, which the softmax provides. On Qwen3-8B-Base, this fork probability decays exponentially with a token's within-response entropy rank at class-specific rates, revealing that most tokens carry negligible forking value. CreditFilter weights each token by an exponential window over the same rank. The window is calibrated to this fork-probability envelope, under an approximately flat fork consequence. CreditFilter needs no extra forward passes and is stabilized by difficulty damping and an entropy-gated fallback. Averaged over three seeds, it outperforms DAPO by 7.7 points on MATH500 and by 10.5 and 9.1 points on AIME24 and AIME25. Its dynamically adaptive variant matches it. The ablations show that both parts matter: ranking tokens within each response rather than across the batch, and matching the window's decay rate to the envelope. Code is available at https://github.com/yoctta/CreditFilter.
arxiv.titleZh: CreditFilter：面向RLVR、按响应内熵排名校准的token权重
arxiv.summaryZh: 无评论家的RLVR通常给每个token相同的优势，而80/20掩码等启发式只偏好高熵token，无法衡量token对最终结果的实际影响。作者把这一影响形式化为forking value（策略下一步token选择上成功概率的方差），并证明其期望沿响应求和恰等于奖励方差；该值可分解为需昂贵续写估计的fork consequence与softmax直接给出的fork probability。在Qwen3-8B-Base上观察到fork概率随token的响应内熵排名指数衰减，据此用同秩上的指数窗分配token信用，无需额外前向，并加入难度阻尼与熵门控回退。三个随机种子平均下，在MATH500超过DAPO 7.7分，在AIME24、AIME25分别超过10.5与9.1分，消融显示响应内排序与窗衰减率匹配均不可或缺。
arxiv.reason: RLVR信用分配新机制，理论动机扎实，实验提升明显

arxiv.title: Speculative Decoding Is Less Speculative Than You Think
arxiv.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates language-model inference by preparing candidate continuations before the target model generates them. Its efficiency depends on how well limited drafting computation anticipates the path the target will actually follow. Anticipating this path involves two sources of uncertainty: the target model's predictions and the randomness of sampling. Yet the former requires a target-model forward pass, while the latter can be fixed before drafting. Building on this observation, we introduce DICE (Draw-Informed Candidate Selection), which pre-samples and synchronizes verification randomness across drafting and verification. By combining these known draws with predictions from an existing drafter, DICE allocates computation toward continuations more likely to be used in the current sampling run. This principle guides node selection throughout draft-tree construction and extends to asynchronous prefetching, where DICE predicts which next-round drafts to prepare. Without additional drafter training or changes to the target sampling distribution, DICE achieves state-of-the-art decoding throughput across diverse settings, with speedups of up to 24.6pp over strong baselines.
arxiv.titleZh: 投机解码没你想的那么投机
arxiv.summaryZh: 投机解码的收益取决于有限的起草算力能否命中目标模型实际会走的续写路径，而这受目标模型预测与采样随机性两类不确定性影响：前者需要目标模型前向，后者却可在起草前固定。DICE（Draw-Informed Candidate Selection）预先采样并在起草与验证之间同步验证阶段的随机数，把已知采样结果与现有 drafter 的预测结合，将算力集中到当前采样运行更可能被接受的续写上，并用于草稿树的节点选择与异步预取中下一轮草稿的预测。无需额外训练 drafter、不改变目标采样分布，在多种设置下取得 SOTA 解码吞吐，相较强基线最高提升 24.6 个百分点。
arxiv.reason: 投机解码推理加速，命中高效推理方向且机制有新意

arxiv.title: Average-Depth Variable Execution via Request-Local Token Routing
arxiv.abstract: Layer skipping can reduce large language model inference costs, but a request budget does not specify how to allocate layer execution across generated tokens. We introduce \method{}, which allows tokens to execute different numbers of layers while matching each request's mean executed depth to a continuous budget. At each routed layer, a router reads the current token state and its request's budget and decides whether to execute the Transformer block. Tokens that skip the block pass through a lightweight residual adapter and write no key/value (K/V) entry at that layer. A single checkpoint serves requests with different budgets in the same batch. Across three LLaMA backbones, six quality metrics, and 13 budgets, AVERT is best or tied for best in 206 of 234 comparisons. Across single- and mixed-budget batches, the mean absolute per-request budget error is at most 1.15 percentage points. When grouping requests by budget leaves batches underfilled, mixing budgets reduces decode time per output token (TPOT) by 4.3--21.2%.
arxiv.titleZh: 通过请求局部token路由实现平均深度可变执行
arxiv.summaryZh: 层跳过能降低大模型推理成本，但请求级预算没有规定如何在生成token间分配层执行。AVERT在每个路由层依据当前token状态和请求预算，决定是否执行Transformer块；被跳过的token经轻量残差适配器传递，且不在该层写入K/V，使单份checkpoint可在同一批次服务不同预算。3个LLaMA主干、6项质量指标、13个预算下，234组比较中206组最优或并列；预算平均绝对误差不超过1.15个百分点，混合预算使TPOT降低4.3%到21.2%，适用于多预算并发的推理服务。
arxiv.reason: 层跳过与请求级token路由，高效推理系统工作，命中系统效率方向

arxiv.title: Benchmarks' Last Exam
arxiv.abstract: Public benchmarks guide model selection, post-training rewards and claims of progress in artificial intelligence, yet leaderboards report aggregate scores without verifying whether each task's prompt, environment and grader agree on what counts as success. How often that agreement fails in contemporary evaluations, and in which direction confirmed defects move scores, has remained unmeasured across grading designs. Here we synthesize task-level quality reviews of 749 tasks across eight frontier benchmarks and 767 public model evaluations spanning closed-form question answering, document rubrics and agentic execution to assess whether prompts, environments and graders align. Task validity stratifies sharply by grading architecture. Closed-form benchmarks revised after public error reporting reach 92.5% verified validity, compared with 29.3% across six multi-step suites that nevertheless already supply 161 verified complex tasks. Rubric suites fail through mismatches between prompts and reference checklists, whereas execution harnesses add incomplete state assertions, shared-channel leaks and grading-time collisions. Across confirmed defects, 71.7% withhold credit from compliant solutions while 28.3% permit shortcut passes, indicating that raw leaderboard ceilings understate frontier capability on many practical tasks. Grading committed patches inside a fresh container cuts confirmed runtime bypasses from 14.7% in shared containers to 2.7% (a 5.5x drop, and 0% in read-only or static suites), showing how targeted maintenance restores existing benchmarks at low cost. As the initial milestone of the long-term Benchmarks' Last Exam initiative, this synthesis launches sustained expansion across wider benchmark coverage and deeper evaluation-quality dimensions so that pursuing leaderboard gains directly advances genuine model capability.
arxiv.comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Initial milestone of the Benchmarks' Last Exam initiative; public reports, structured data, and code archived at https://benchmarks-last-exam.com/benchmarks/ and https://github.com/ZekkiCat/Benchmarks-Last-Exam
arxiv.titleZh: 基准的最后考试
arxiv.summaryZh: 公开榜单只报告聚合分数，却不核查任务的提示、环境与评分器对「成功」的定义是否一致。这项工作汇总了8个前沿基准上749个任务的任务级质量审查，以及767次公开模型评测，覆盖闭卷问答、文档rubric与agent执行三类评分架构。结果发现：经公开纠错修订的闭卷基准验证有效率达92.5%，而六个多步套件仅29.3%；已确认的缺陷中71.7%会错判合规解答为不通过，28.3%则允许走捷径通过；在全新容器内评测提交的补丁，可把已确认的运行时绕过率从共享容器的14.7%降到2.7%。这为低成本维护现有基准、提升评测可靠性提供了可操作的分类与修复路径。
arxiv.reason: 大规模审计基准任务有效性并给出可操作修复，直击评测可靠性

arxiv.title: WEIR: Watershed Exploration and Drift-Aware Prefix Shrinkage for Multi-Turn Agent Reinforcement Learning
arxiv.abstract: Multi-turn language model agents often receive only a single binary reward at the end of a long interaction trajectory, making it difficult to separate decisive decisions from routine steps or estimate accurate intermediate values.
